Description.text: Down the ramp behind Marlowe's. No extra cut - but don't lead the police home: it won't work with a patrol car on your tail.
East end of Main Street, past Pine Street at the roadworks. Even a chase ends out there - the fence takes 10% for collecting from the woods.
Park between the cars by Main Street and kill the engine (6 seconds still). Close to Ashgrove Lane; someone has to fetch the van later (5%). Not while you are being chased.

FoundText.text: Bills for Harold Vance. A jeweller's appraisal of Margaret's diamond ring ("kept in the bathroom cabinet"). And a birthday card for Thomas Vance, aged 9 - postmarked 1987.
A big TV and a game console, a mantel clock, a silver candlestick. The TV is on. Nobody is watching it.
A laptop on the desk, an old camera by the bookcase. The desk drawer has a little lock.
A spare key, taped under the gnome. You pocket it.

Prompt.text: Watch the house for a while

FoundText.text: Mrs Vance at the upstairs window, pearls on, not moving. Nobody comes or goes. No alarm box, no dog. You get the feeling she watched you back.
Shelves, a furnace, an old trunk. On the trunk lies a child's drawing of this house - every window coloured in black.
